## Activity

During November 2023, Market Eye Clinic recorded 468 captures. This activity reflects the volume of retinal images submitted for review during the month. Capture numbers should continue to be monitored as part of routine site reporting, with any material changes considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 94 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 20.1. This indicates that a substantial proportion of images could not be used for grading. The site should review image capture practice and ensure that staff are aware of the requirements for obtaining suitable images. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be investigated and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 95 referable results during the reporting period. These results require the appropriate follow-up in line with established clinical pathways. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 2. Maintaining timely grading remains important, particularly where findings may require onward assessment. The activity, image quality and grading measures should be reviewed together to support service improvement at Market Eye Clinic.
